query: Dubai UAE taxi Uber Careem fare per km base fare minimum 2026
snippet: The minimum taxi fare in Dubai is AED 12 for street-hail rides and AED 13 for app-based taxi bookings, following an RTA update introduced in November 2025. The per kilometre charge is AED 2.26.

query: Dubai UAE taxi Uber Careem fare per km base fare minimum 2026
source: grabonuae.ae (Careem vs Uber vs Dubai Taxis: Best Option in UAE 2026)
snippet: UberX base fare is AED 5.00 by day (6 AM-10 PM) and AED 5.50 at night, with a per-km rate of AED 2.26, a per-minute idle charge of AED 0.50, and a booking fee of AED 1.20. Careem Economy and UberX have the same base fare of AED 5.00 and the same per-km rate of AED 2.26 in 2026.
